executive.title: Jensen Huang says he’s found a ‘brand new’ $200B market for Nvidia
executive.description: The next big thing for Nvidia will be CPUs for AI agents, $200 billion worth, CEO Jensen Huang predicts.

executive.title: Intuit to lay off over 3,000 employees to refocus on AI
executive.description: In a memo to employees, CEO Sasan Goodarzi said the layoffs are meant to reduce complexity, simplify the company's corporate structure, and deliver better AI products.

executive.title: Cloudflare says AI made 1,100 jobs obsolete, even as revenue hit a record high
executive.description: Cloudflare announced its first large-scale layoff. CEO Matthew Prince says because of AI efficiency gains, the company doesn't need as many support roles.

executive.title: Tech CEOs are apparently suffering from AI psychosis
executive.description: "CEOs are uniquely prone to AI psychosis," Box CEO Aaron Levie opines. Maybe that explains the almost religious belief in AI productivity gains.

executive.title: Cisco cuts nearly 4,000 jobs to spend more on AI, reports ‘record quarterly revenue’
executive.description: This is Cisco's latest layoff in recent years, while the company's chief executive touts record revenue and growth.

executive.title: Redwood Materials loses COO amid layoffs, restructuring
executive.description: Former Tesla executive Chris Lister is retiring, and at least three other VPs have left Redwood around the recent restructuring, TechCrunch has learned.

executive.title: Snap is cutting 1,000 jobs, 16% of its workforce
executive.description: The company cites advancements in AI for the cuts. CEO Evan Spiegel also wrote that the company is closing more than 300 open roles. Snap had about 5,261 full-time employees as of December 2025.

executive.title: Defense tech darling Mach Industries hits $1.8B valuation, a 4x jump in a year

executive.title: Making sense of the debate over AI psychosis
executive.description: On the latest episode of Equity, we debate whether tech CEOs are "uniquely prone to AI psychosis."

funding.title: Ethos raises $22.75M from a16z for its expert network with voice onboarding
funding.description: Ethos says it is onboarding 35,000 experts per week.

funding.title: Sierra raises $950M as the race to own enterprise AI gets serious
funding.description: The raise gives Sierra more than $1 billion to work with — capital the company says it will use to become the "global standard" for AI-powered customer experiences.

funding.title: Meta reportedly considering layoffs that could affect 20% of the company
funding.description: These layoffs could help Facebook's parent company offset its aggressive spending on AI infrastructure, as well as AI-related acquisitions and hiring.

funding.title: Ex-Anduril engineer raises $42M to build the Amazon of composite parts
funding.description: Layup Parts co-founder Zack Eakin has drawn on a motorsports background, and his experience working for Palmer Luckey and Elon Musk, to tackle making faster, cheaper, and better composites.

funding.title: Focused Energy raises whopping $240M Series A for laser-powered fusion tech
funding.description: Another fusion startup has raised another a massive round to make this type of power a reality.

funding.title: Board, the new game startup from Mirror founder Brynn Putnam, raises $20M, has already sold thousands
funding.description: Board, the startup building what it calls "together tech" designed to bring people into the same room, has closed a Series A led by Union Square Ventures.

funding.title: ZeroDrift raises $10M to protect AI models from themselves
funding.description: A new AI compliance service sits between AI models and end users to flag and replace any messages that might present a compliance problem.

layoffs.title: GM just laid off hundreds of IT workers to hire those with stronger AI skills
layoffs.description: Some of the positions focus on AI-native development, data engineering and analytics, cloud-based engineering, and agent and model development as well as prompt engineering and new AI workflows.

layoffs.title: Truecaller slashes 70 jobs amid declining ad sales
layoffs.description: Truecaller's ad revenue declined by 44%, leading to the layoffs.

layoffs.title: Coinbase to lay off 14% of staff as part of broader restructuring
layoffs.description: The restructuring is aimed at addressing market volatility and increasing the use of AI tools to improve efficiency.

layoffs.title: Meta to cut 10% of jobs, or 8,000 employees, report says
layoffs.description: According to an internal memo, Meta plans to begin its sweeping layoffs on May 20.

layoffs.title: Redwood Materials lays off 10% in restructuring to chase energy storage business
layoffs.description: The company is restructuring some teams to accommodate a booming energy storage business, according to emails viewed by TechCrunch.

layoffs.title: Digg lays off staff and shuts down app as company retools
layoffs.description: Digg laid off a significant number of staff and shut down its app, but says it's not giving up on the startup.
